purpose: Reads a pasted list of titles, each followed by a line giving its points, and answers with the titles and their points in the order given. A made-up agent for the test writer's own tests.

users.who: a person who pastes a list
users.wants: each title with its points, and a total

features.name: Read the points
features.does: Reads each title and the points line under it, in the order given.

inputs.name: the list
inputs.about: Lines of text: a title, then its points line.

requirements.shall: The agent shall recognize a points line only by the pattern ^(\d+) points?$.
The agent shall read at most 30 items from one list.
The agent shall end its reply with the words "Read by points-reader."
The agent shall keep the titles in the order given.

acceptance.gherkin:
Scenario: two titles with their points
  Given a list "Alpha\n12 points\nBeta\n1 point"
  When it is read
  Then the items are Alpha with 12 and Beta with 1
  And the reply ends "Read by points-reader."

Scenario: a list longer than the limit
  Given a list of 31 titles, each with a points line
  When it is read
  Then only the first 30 are read

features.name: Refuse a list with no points
features.does: Refuses a list with no points line in it, in fixed words.

requirements.shall: The agent shall refuse a list with no points line with the words "No points lines were found."

acceptance.gherkin:
Scenario: a list with no points
  Given a list "Alpha\nBeta"
  When it is read
  Then it is refused with "No points lines were found."

interfaces.name: readPoints
interfaces.about: The reading, which other code imports.

interfaces.name: out/points.json
interfaces.about: What the job writes, which another program reads.

constraints.shall: The agent shall finish one list within 10 seconds.
